text: Maria : Okay, let ' s get started. Thanks, everyone, for joining the weekly planning meeting for the Riverside library renovation. After the change orders for the roof drainage and the new fire alarm panel, we have about two hundred and ten thousand left. The roof drainage alone was, uh, eighty - seven thousand, which was more than we expected, because the old pipes were in much worse shape than the survey showed.
